Program Overview

The HIER Lab (Human-Interactive Embodied Robotics) at North Carolina State University, led by Prof. Jaemin Lee, is offering fully funded PhD positions in whole-body control, humanoid robotics, and manipulation. The lab focuses on developing advanced control algorithms for robots that interact with humans and environments.

Funding & Benefits

  • Tuition Fees: Full coverage (in-state and out-of-state) for 4-5 years
  • Stipend: $32,000 - $36,000 per year (competitive) for 4-5 years
  • Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage
  • Research Funding: Access to lab equipment and computing resources
  • Conference Travel: Funding for international conferences annually

Research Focus

  • Whole-Body Control: Developing control algorithms for humanoid robots
  • Humanoid Robotics: Designing and controlling robots with human-like morphology
  • Manipulation: Advanced manipulation techniques for complex objects
  • Human-Robot Interaction: Safe and intuitive interaction
  • Safety-Critical Control: Ensuring safe operation in human environments

Eligibility Criteria

  • Academic Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
  • Research Experience: Prior experience in robotics, control systems, or dynamics (preferred)
  • GPA: 3.5+ (on 4.0 scale) for competitive application
  • English Proficiency: TOEFL 90+ or IELTS 6.5+ (for international students)

Application Process

  1. Contact Prof. Lee with CV and research statement.
  2. Submit graduate application to NC State Engineering.
  3. Departmental review.
  4. Interview with lab members.
  5. Funding decision.
  6. Begin PhD program.

Required Documents

  • CV/Resume highlighting academic and research experience
  • Research Statement (2-3 pages)
  • Transcripts (all undergraduate and graduate records)
  • Three Letters of Recommendation
  • English Proficiency Scores (TOEFL or IELTS if applicable)

  • Collaborations with leading robotics companies.
  • Access to advanced robotics labs and testing facilities.

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

About North Carolina State University

North Carolina State University is a public research university in Raleigh, North Carolina. Part of the University of North Carolina System, NC State offers programmes in engineering, agriculture, science, design, business and other fields. Its teaching and research connect with industry and communities through practical problem solving and scientific discovery.

Official website: https://www.ncsu.edu

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 15 December 2026 (Priority). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
